scientific_integrity: Theorem follows from explicit normal-form and stabilizer proof; finite verification is corroborative, not general certification.
scientific_limitations: Only F_q-linear isomorphisms of perfect monomial structure evolution algebras; excludes arbitrary perfect algebras and semilinear equivalence. Some older permutation-specific literature could not be inspected in full; historical priority is qualified.
title: Doubling-orbit normal forms and automorphism orders of finite-field permutation evolution algebras
